home.subtitle: Play the psychological horror visual novel online, free
home.whatIsP1: A psychological horror visual novel from independent developer Garula (Neko Bueno), published on itch.io. It has built a passionate international following thanks to its haunting gothic artwork, morally complex characters, and deeply branching narrative. Set in a mysterious circus that appears only at night, the story pulls you into a world where nothing is as it seems.
home.whatIsP2: You arrive as a stranger at a remote circus that materializes at the edge of a fog-shrouded town. What begins as curiosity quickly becomes entanglement. The five performers — Pierrot, Harlequin, Jester, the Ticket Taker, and the Doctor — sense something in you they have been waiting for. Every choice shapes your fate and theirs across two intense days.
features: Five romanceable characters: Pierrot, Harlequin, Jester, Ticket Taker, and Doctor each with unique story routes and multiple endings
Branching narrative system where every choice shifts character affinity and unlocks or locks entire story branches
Gothic psychological horror atmosphere brought to life through original hand-drawn artwork and a haunting soundtrack
Official Simplified Chinese language support alongside English for a broader player base
Regular content updates from the developer including new scenes, endings, and character routes
Free to play directly in your browser or download for Windows, macOS, and Linux from itch.io
home.charactersP: Five performers shape every playthrough: Pierrot, Harlequin, Jester, the Ticket Taker, and the Doctor. Each has a unique route, ending set, and relationship arc with the protagonist.
home.howToPlayP1: Playing is simple. The game runs entirely in your browser — no download or installation needed. Click the play button above to launch this visual novel directly on this page. It uses a classic interface: read the story, make choices at key moments, and watch how your decisions shape the narrative.
home.howToPlayP2: Each playthrough takes roughly 2 to 3 hours depending on how carefully you read and explore. There are five main story routes, each tied to a different performer: Pierrot, Harlequin, Jester, the Ticket Taker, and the Doctor. Your first playthrough naturally leads toward one or two characters based on your early choices.
home.howToPlayP3: New players should focus on enjoying the atmosphere and characters rather than optimizing for a specific ending on their first run. Multiple playthroughs are rewarded — each route reveals new scenes, dialogue, and backstory you cannot see in a single run.

faqItems.q: Is this game free to play?
faqItems.a: Yes. It is completely free to play in your browser on this site. You can also download it for Windows, macOS, and Linux from the official itch.io page.

faqItems.q: Do I need to download anything?
faqItems.a: No. It runs directly in your browser. Just click the play button on this page and the game loads instantly. No downloads or plugins required.

faqItems.q: How long does a playthrough take?
faqItems.a: A single playthrough takes about 2 to 3 hours. To experience all five character routes and endings, expect 10 to 15 hours total across multiple playthroughs.

Yes. The game includes a built-in save system that lets you save at any decision point. You can create multiple save slots, which is useful when you want to explore different story branches without committing to a single path. Progress is stored locally in your browser.

faqItems.q: What makes this visual novel unique?
faqItems.a: It stands out for its gothic psychological horror atmosphere, morally complex characters, and deeply branching narrative where every choice carries real weight.

faqItems.q: Will progress carry over between devices?
faqItems.a: Saves are stored locally in your browser. If you want to continue on another device, you can download the game from itch.io and transfer your save files.

faqItems.q: Is this game suitable for all ages?
faqItems.a: No. It is rated 18+ and contains mature themes including psychological horror, possessive relationships, and dark romance.

faqItems.q: What is the difference between routes?
faqItems.a: Each character route offers a completely different perspective. Pierrot focuses on psychological dependence. Harlequin explores chaos and performance. Jester examines entertainment ethics. The Ticket Taker reveals the deepest lore. The Doctor contains the most intimate and unsettling content.
It runs in most modern mobile browsers, though the experience is optimized for desktop and tablet. For the best experience, use a desktop or laptop computer.

home.storyP1: The Freak Circus begins when you stumble upon a traveling circus that has arrived in town unannounced. Drawn by an inexplicable pull, you step past the entrance into a world where reality bends. Each performer offers a different perspective on the circus hidden history. Pierrot weeps through his performances but sees everything. Harlequin laughs too loudly and masks a violent past.
home.storyP2: As night falls on the second day, the masks begin to slip. You are forced to confront uncomfortable truths about desire, control, and the stories we tell ourselves. The endings range from tender to terrifying, and the game does not judge whichever path you choose — it simply shows you where it leads. Each conclusion leaves you with questions only a second playthrough can answer, making the experience feel as layered and unpredictable as the circus itself.
tipsList: Take your time reading each scene. The Freak Circus rewards attention to small details in dialogue and environment.
Do not reload saves to undo choices on your first playthrough. Your natural decisions lead to the most meaningful experience.
Play through at least twice. A second playthrough of The Freak Circus reveals dialogue and scenes you missed the first time.
Pay close attention to the Ticket Taker. He says more than he appears to say.
Each character route has a Good Ending and at least one Bad Ending. Refer to the walkthrough after your first play.
Use the save system at each major decision point. You can reload later to explore the branch you did not take without losing progress on your current route.
home.whyPlayText: This visual novel has earned a dedicated following because it offers something rare in the genre: genuinely difficult choices that carry real emotional weight. It does not hold your hand or tell you which choice is right. The art style — all hand-drawn gothic illustrations — sets it apart from typical anime-style titles. Combined with a branching narrative that tracks over a dozen variables per playthrough, it delivers a different experience every time you play.
home.storyP3: The circus itself is a character in its own right. The tents shift positions between visits, the carnival games seem to know your thoughts, and the performers remember conversations you never had. By the time you realize the circus is alive, it may already be too late to leave.
home.gameplayP: Gameplay centers on dialogue choices that appear throughout each day. Some choices are timed, adding tension to conversations. Others are deceptively simple — a single word can redirect an entire character route. The game tracks affinity levels with each character, hidden flags for story branches, and cumulative choices that affect the final ending. Even seemingly minor interactions can cascade into major consequences later. The save system lets you revisit key decision points, making it easy to explore alternative paths without restarting from scratch. Each choice matters, and no two playthroughs ever feel quite the same.

characters.title: Characters of The Freak Circus
characters.subtitle: Five extraordinary performers. Five routes. One fate.

list.name: Pierrot
list.description: Controlled, melancholic, and intensely perceptive. Pierrot is the emotional anchor of the circus, performing sorrow for crowds who laugh at his tears. His route is the most psychologically demanding and offers the most lore about the circus's true nature.
list.routeTip: Choose introspective and empathetic dialogue in Day 1. Avoid defiance in Day 2 to unlock the Good Ending.

list.name: Harlequin
list.description: Unpredictable and theatrical, Harlequin masks a turbulent past behind an ever-shifting performance. His relationship with Pierrot is one of the game's central dynamics.
list.routeTip: Select the red balloon in Day 1. Use bold, playful responses during tent encounters.

list.name: Jester
list.description: Jester exists between the other performers, neither fully loyal nor fully antagonistic. His route explores the ethics of entertainment and what it means to make others laugh.
list.routeTip: Jester's route unlocks in Day 2. Respond with humor but avoid direct confrontation.

list.name: Ticket Taker
list.description: The first character you meet. The Ticket Taker controls who enters and who leaves, and has watched everything at this circus for far longer than the others realize.
list.routeTip: Engage directly with every question the Ticket Taker asks. His route requires persistence.

list.name: Doctor
list.description: The Doctor's route is the most recently expanded and contains some of the game's darkest content. He is methodical, intimate, and deeply unsettling.
list.routeTip: The Doctor's content is largely contained to Day 2. Accept his examination scenes to progress his route.

walkthrough.title: The Freak Circus Walkthrough
walkthrough.subtitle: Step-by-step guides for every route, ending, and hidden scene.
walkthrough.spoilerText: This page contains major spoilers for all routes and endings. Play through at least Day 1 before consulting this guide.
walkthrough.day1P1: Day 1 establishes your affinity with each of the five characters through a series of carnival encounters. Your choices in the first 20 minutes determine which routes become available in Day 2.
walkthrough.day1P2: Key branching points in Day 1 include the entrance interaction with the Ticket Taker, the tent choice, and the evening meal conversation.
walkthrough.pierrotP1: Select introspective and empathetic options throughout Day 1. In the tent scene, follow the white cloak. During Day 2, choose understanding over resistance to unlock Pierrot's Good Ending.
walkthrough.pierrotP2: See the full Pierrot route article in our blog.
walkthrough.harlequinP1: Interact with the red balloon during the Day 1 carnival opening. Use bold, playful responses in the main tent. Harlequin's route escalates quickly in Day 2, so embrace the chaos rather than resist it.
